A service provider WAN service where CE devices are Layer 3 (not Layer 2) adjacent with their connected PE device, unlike Metro Ethernet

more.text: PE routers insert an MPLS header between a customer packet's Layer 2 and Layer 3 headers, which tells the shared MPLS core how to forward it while keeping different customers' traffic segregated.

sides.text: CE and PE routers are routing neighbours (static routes or a routing protocol); internally the provider uses MP-BGP to redistribute customer routes across the MPLS core

more.text: Since MPLS is a Layer 3 service, it can run over a variety of Layer 2 access link types, unlike MetroE which requires Ethernet access links. MPLS also enables Layer 3 QoS: CE devices can mark packets for the provider to recognise and prioritise.

sides.text: Let offices use cheap Internet access instead of a private WAN, while still needing encryption, authentication, data integrity and anti-replay protection

sides.text: VPN tunnel endpoints are typically routers or firewalls; unencrypted internal traffic is encrypted at one endpoint, sent across the Internet, and decrypted at the other

more.text: Performs the roles of ARP and then some.

sides.text: A host sends a multicast Neighbour Solicitation (NS) for a target's IPv6 address; the target replies with a unicast Neighbour Advertisement (NA)

more.text: NAs can also be sent unsolicited to FF02::1 (all-nodes) to announce a host's IPv6/MAC address to everyone. show ipv6 neighbours lists discovered hosts, analogous to show mac address-table dynamic.

sides.text: A host sends a Router Solicitation (RS) to FF02::2 (all-routers); routers respond with a Router Advertisement (RA), unicast or to FF02::1

more.text: The RA contains the router's subnet ID, prefix length and link-local address.

sides.text: A host uses NDP RS/RA to discover the subnet ID and prefix length, generates an interface ID (via EUI-64 or randomly), then runs DAD to confirm the resulting address is unused
A host sends a Neighbour Solicitation for its own proposed IPv6 address
